name: Vitamin D Correction
title: Test vitamin D and supplement to sufficiency.
subtitle: Tested Supplement
rationale: Testing first and dosing to the result corrects a real deficiency without guessing at a number.

evidence.summary: Correcting deficiency is well supported; large trials in replete adults were null for primary outcomes, so test-then-treat beats blind dosing.

indications: 25(OH)D has never been measured or came back low.
Winter months with minimal midday sun exposure.
avoidWhen: High-dose supplementation without a blood level.
History of hypercalcemia or kidney stones unless cleared by a physician.
